scope: Only transport reading for the three existing register/unregister/send push endpoints; all business workflows remain separate.
optionalExplicit16384Cap: Existing helper parameter only. No productive caller uses a16KiB cap, and none is introduced.

originalReproduction.limits: Native Requests/streams and named fallback doubles only. No actual notification, provider, recipient, customer account or database; supplied transport markers are not proof of an externally exploitable leak.

change.decoder: Original nonfatal UTF8 and initial BOM behavior, including split-byte sequences.
change.limits: Stream path counts actual raw bytes. The existing req.text fallback counts the returned string reencoded to UTF8; their intentional malformed-byte asymmetry is retained.
change.opaqueFallback: The fallback promise is time/abort bounded and size-checked after resolution. It cannot provide incremental allocation control inside an opaque text implementation; real Request streams use the incrementally bounded stream path.
change.ownership: An invocation-local WeakSet recognises only locally created400/413/interruption errors. Foreign stream/text/acquisition failures normalize to a neutral500. A separate private WeakSet enables408 mapping only for genuine local interruption errors; supplied403/408 error instances cannot masquerade as reader errors.
change.guards: Check before body access, before/after awaited reads or fallback text, on EOF, before/after JSON parsing, and immediately after each route awaits JSON before validation or subsequent workflows.
change.cleanup: Cancel only the acquired reader, at most once, without awaiting its promise. Clear timer, remove abort listener and attempt release; cleanup rejection cannot replace a result.
change.notPromised: No rollback or cancellation of workflows/provider deliveries already begun; no new rate policy or general attack-prevention guarantee.

preservation.vmFixture: test-account-generation.cjs adds only the native setTimeout and clearTimeout globals. Reversing those two bindings restores its complete original bytes and all assertions.

validation.actualTimeouts: Native incomplete stream and opaque fallback both hit the genuine8000ms timeout in the same test; observed test duration8019.7145ms. No simulated-clock deadline claim.
validation.routeTests: Three post-read aborts stop before payload validation and subsequent DB/provider work; send still performs exactly one synthetic pre-body administrator check. Sandbox/session/origin/bearer/admin ordering is checked.
validation.testedSourceMode: Only these four explicitly named proposed push sources are read from the workspace; no old-test overlay or historical-assertion projection is used.
validation.network: NoNet preload; all account/provider/DB effects are explicit isolated doubles.
